description: NaLiSe crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to five equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent LiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with six equivalent LiSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.05 Å. Li¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form LiSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent LiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent LiSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Li-Se bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.65 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Na¹⁺ and four equivalent Li¹⁺ atoms.
